subject: general
question: How many sodium atoms are there in one molecule of sodium peroxide?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Two.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• Sodium Peroxide

 
 
• It is an inorganic compound with the formula Na2O2.
 
• This yellowish solid is the product of sodium ignited in excess oxygen.
 
• It is a strong base.
 
• This metal peroxide exists in several hydrates and peroxyhydrates.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Sodium

 
 
• It is a chemical element with the **symbol Na **and **atomic number 11.**
 
• ​Sodium is silver-white colour metal with malleable and ductile properties.
 
• It is a metal that can** easily be cut with a knife.**
 
• It is a good conductor of heat and electricity.
